column4: Makefile PORT 8877 -> 8800 and the matching line in the project's CLAUDE.md; scripts/repo-tools.sh get_port() is canonical and was already right. No other 8877 in live files.
One scrollable line at <=600px, borrowing the hidden-scrollbar pattern .cat-rail-inner already uses. No '+N more' affordance invented.

49 card icons converted from to masked , taking var(--card-accent); 4 third-party brand marks and the raster logo stay . Guarded with @supports. One defect found and fixed: a relative url() inside a custom property resolves against the stylesheet that substitutes the var(), not the HTML that declared it, so all 49 masks 404'd as /css/assets/... until the paths were made root-relative.

scripts/icon-sheet.py generates docs/icon-sheet.html from index.html + the icon dir: all 54 card icons at 60px and 28px, each in its own card's accent, raw brand marks flagged. Stale docs/icon-comparison.html removed (git 0e3afe3). First attempt bracketed cards by regex and found 29 of 54 because Soon and multi-tool cards are <div>; rewritten to anchor on the icon and walk back to the nearest --card-accent.

Confirmed in Playwright (real Chromium, rAF running at 126fps, 11 pills booted). Constellation collapse eased 200 -> 147.7 -> 77.5 -> 25.5 -> 11.4 -> 0 over ~320ms, matching the 0.3s transition. Reveal scroll animated 0 -> 291 and landed exactly on the computed target of 291. Mobile chip row at the worst case (11 chips): 23px, one line, scrollable, no sideways body scroll.
